subject: Request: Adaptive benchmark + limited exclusive access for Horizon Systems (DEAL-4821)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Adaptive benchmark + limited exclusive access for Horizon Systems (DEAL-4821)

Hi Laura / Rishi —

Quick summary: Horizon (prospective enterprise, manufacturing vertical) is asking for a set of clauses that are high risk for us: a de facto MFN-style benchmark protection tied to public pricing, plus a 24-month exclusivity for a specific automation product line in North America. They are pushing hard in procurement — opportunity is $3.1M ARR committed over 2 years if we accept their commercial asks.

Key asks from Horizon:
- Benchmark protection: if a competitor offers them a lower price tied to our published benchmark, Redwood must match (they phrase as MFN/benchmark).
- Exclusivity: 24 months, NA, for product line ‘Horizon AutoFlow’ (prevents us selling the same feature to other manufacturing customers in NA).
- Upfront 30% discount first year, volume-based overage credits.

Why this is risky: 24-month exclusivity + MFN benchmarking exposes us to aggressive parity demands and reduces our ability to pilot new pricing/partners in a growing vertical. The benchmark language is vague and could cascade across other deals.

What I'm asking: Exec exception evaluation. I have attached the latest SOW and a redline (horizon-benchmark-markup.docx) showing our suggested carve-outs. Proposed alternative (sales view):
- Narrow exclusivity to 12 months and limited to the specific SKU set in SOW (not whole product family).
- Replace MFN/indefinite benchmark with a 90-day price-matching window and a cap on benchmark adjustments (max 7.5% of gross price).
- Add termination for convenience if business metrics not met (revenue < 50% forecast after 6 months).

Attachments: Horizon_Systems_SOW_v2.pdf (redlined), redwood-pricing-template.xlsx, horizon-benchmark-markup.docx

Next steps I need from you: is this something we can approve at deal desk level with conditions, or do I escalate to Marissa for exec signoff? Also need a quick read on potential legal obligations we must keep. Horizon wants a signed SOW by June 12.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-05T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Adaptive benchmark + limited exclusive access for Horizon Systems (DEAL-4821)

Ben — thanks for the clear summary and the redline. A few immediate points from Deal Desk POV: 

1) MFN/benchmark: We should not accept an open-ended MFN. A 90-day matching window + a hard cap (single-digit %) is reasonable; I prefer 5-7% rather than 7.5% unless Finance signs off. If Horizon insists on linking to a public benchmark we must define the benchmark methodology explicitly and exclude partner/marketplace special promos.

2) Exclusivity: 24 months is too broad. Recommend 12 months max, SKU-level scope, and carve out channel/marketplace launches. Also add measurable KPI exit (revenue attainment) and a non-renewal clause if metrics are missed.

3) Discount: 30% is high; propose structured ramp (year 1 20% with performance milestones, year 2 10% renewal).

I need Legal to confirm language for audit/metrics and Finance to run a sensitivity model if we cap benchmark at 7.5% vs 5%. Rishi — can you authorize us to escalate to Marissa for an exception given the MFN + exclusivity exposure? If Exec approves, we must also require a signed addendum to limit forward effect and include explicit audit rights.

I attached the pricing template (redwood-pricing-template.xlsx) with a sketch of impact.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-05T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Adaptive benchmark + limited exclusive access for Horizon Systems (DEAL-4821)

Laura / Ben — escalate to Marissa. The combination of MFN-like language and exclusivity materially increases competitive exposure and sets precedent. Please put a short executive memo together (1 page) that lays out: revenue upside, downside scenarios, suggested mitigation (language + caps), and required conditions (audit, termination, KPI gates). Marissa — I think this warrants your signoff because it’s both strategic and precedent-setting.

I'll loop Finance and Legal for quick inputs; Connor, please prioritize a sensitivity table showing 5% vs 7.5% cap implications on blended annual margin. Ben, please prepare the 1-page memo and a marked SOW for Marissa.

Rishi
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-05T17:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Adaptive benchmark + limited exclusive access for Horizon Systems (DEAL-4821)

Thanks — attached is a 1-page exec memo and a clean SOW with in-line suggested language. I highlighted the compromise we can accept and also included a fallback 'pilot clause' to expire exclusivity if adoption metrics aren't met.

I also spoke with Horizon procurement — they can move faster if we close by June 12 but said they could agree to 12 months and a performance gate if we firm up the matching window and cap. They want to see the final SOW by EOD June 7.

Attachments: horizon-benchmark-markup.docx (redline), Horizon_Systems_SOW_v2.pdf (clean), exec-memo-DEAL-4821.pdf

Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-06T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Adaptive benchmark + limited exclusive access for Horizon Systems (DEAL-4821)

Team — I reviewed the memo and the redlines. I approve a limited exception with the following mandatory conditions: 

1) Exclusivity: 12 months maximum, North America only, and strictly limited to the SKU list in the attached SOW. No channel or marketplace carve-outs granted.
2) Benchmark: Replace MFN with a 90-day price-match window tied to a defined benchmark index (we will codify the index and exclude marketplace/promotional pricing). Cap the adjustment at 7.5% (absolute max).
3) Discount: Limit upfront discount to 20% year 1, staged to 10% in year 2 contingent on achieving revenue milestones; no blanket 30%.
4) Audit & KPIs: Include audit rights (quarterly sampling) and a KPI gate (if revenue < 60% of forecast after 6 months Redwood may terminate exclusivity without penalty).
5) Legal/Finance artifacts: Legal must prepare final contract language excluding open-ended MFN; Finance sign-off required on final cap before signature.

This approval is conditional on Legal translating the redlines into contract language that includes the exclusions above and on Finance confirming the 7.5% cap impact is tolerable. If those two checks pass, Ben — you have exec approval to finalize with Horizon.

Marissa Cole
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
